about_the_game:
Build your dream life in a living online multiplayer city. Customize your avatar & home, meet friends, play mini-games, and explore with your Yooca companion.

Welcome to Yooca: Your Life, a cozy-yet-ambitious social life simulation game set in a living online city where every day feels like a new chapter. Start from scratch, shape your identity, build your space, and grow your story with your adorable Yooca companion always by your side.

✨ In One Look

Explore the living online city

Customize your avatar

Decorate your apartment

Play mini-games with your friends. Level-up your skills and earn in-game currency (Younits)

🗣️ User Gameplay Reviews

⭐ “I logged in to explore for 10 minutes and ended up playing for 2 hours.”

⭐ “It’s like living in a cozy online city. I keep discovering new things.”

⭐ “Decorating my apartment is addictive. I’m proud of it.”

⭐ “Mini-games are surprisingly fun… and rewards feel meaningful.”

⭐ “My Yooca is adorable. I’m weirdly attached already.”

✨ Game Highlights
✅ Build your dream life

Start from scratch and grow through skills, traits, daily goals, quests, and meaningful unlocks.

✅ A living online city

Explore districts, discover activities, and meet other players living their lives too.

✅ Expression is gameplay

Customize your avatar and design your home. Your style becomes part of your identity.

✅ Your Yooca companion

Cute, expressive, and always by your side. Your Yooca makes the journey feel personal.

🐾 Character Introduction

You

You are the main character, not a preset role. Define your identity through your choices, style, goals, and growth.

Your Yooca Companion

Your Yooca follows you everywhere, reacts to moments, and brings warmth, charm, and surprises to daily life.

📖 Story

This is your story.

Yooca: Your Life isn’t a linear narrative. It’s a life journey you build. You begin with a fresh start in a vibrant city: make friends, discover activities, build your home, develop skills, and chase personal goals.

🌆 Explore a Living Online City

The city isn’t just scenery — it’s your playground. Explore lively hubs, cozy hidden corners, and activity spots that keep evolving. Whether you want to chill, progress, socialize, or compete, there’s always something to do.

🧍 Customize Your Avatar

Your avatar is how the city recognizes you. Customize hairstyles, outfits, accessories, and expressions  unlock more styles through progression, rewards, and limited-time events.

🏠 Your Home, Your Space

Design your apartment and fill it with furniture, decorations, and collectible items. Invite friends over to hang out and show off your space. Over time, your home becomes a visual record of your journey.

🎮 Mini-Games & Activities

Yooca is packed with mini-games and city activities. Play for fun, mastery, rewards, or leaderboard glory and use earnings to unlock fashion, furniture, and collectibles.

Barista Challenge

Rhythm Nova

🎯 Progression That Feels Like Life

Progress isn’t just numbers, it’s identity. Grow through skills, build long-term traits, complete goals and quests, and unlock new customization options that reflect your personal journey.

👥 Multiplayer & Social Play

Yooca shines brightest when shared. Meet players in the city, chat and emote, play activities together, visit apartments, and create memorable moments.

🎮 Controls

Keyboard & Mouse

  • W/A/S/D: Move

  • Mouse: Camera / view

  • E: Interact

  • Space: Jump

  • Esc / M: Menu / Map

  • Enter: Chat

Controller

  • Controller support: Planned

  • Recommended: dual-stick movement + interaction buttons

Controls may evolve during Early Access based on community feedback.

💬 Developer Comments

Yooca: Your Life is built for players who love cozy living worlds, meaningful progression, and social moments that feel real. We want to create a city that feels like a second home, a place you can return to daily, not because you have to but because you want to.

As Yooca grows, expect new activities, mini-games, customization options, events, and more ways to interact with your Yooca companion. Thank you for being part of this journey.

Yooca Team

✅ Key Features

  • Life simulation progression: skills, traits, goals, quests, unlocks

  • Living online city: explore districts, discover activities, meet other players

  • Deep customization: avatar, outfits, accessories, expressions

  • Apartment design: decorate, collect, and invite friends

  • Mini-games & activities: rewards, mastery, challenges

  • Yooca companion: expressive and always by your side

  • Multiplayer social play: chat, emote, hang out and play together

✨ Welcome to Yooca.

Step into the city, meet your Yooca companion, and start building your dream life today.

short_description: Build your dream life in Yooca, a cozy multiplayer life sim set in a vibrant online city. Express yourself through deep avatar and home customization, bond with your loyal Yooca companion, and join a heartwarming community. From mini-games to chilling with friends, how will you live your best live?
